name: Tsugaru (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Tsugaru city emblem in green, yellow and light blue: a green ring with yellow and light blue discs.
history: Municipal flag of Tsugaru, a city in Aomori Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 11 February 2005.
